pull.title: MINOR: Update documentation version references to 4.4
pull.body:
Update outdated documentation version references to 4.4. Adjust the
tiered storage example to use the test fixtures JAR, as
`LocalTieredStorage` has moved to `src/testFixtures`.

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

reviews.body:
LGTM

I grepped docs/ for 4.3.0, 4.3.1, 4.3.x, blob/4.3 and /43/. The remaining hits are all historical release notes, so nothing is missed.
